sources.title: 朱德潤《存復齋文集》卷四〈湘中廖如川談三命序〉
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/存復齋文集_(四部叢刊本)/卷四
sources.quality_notes: Text names four birth fields and five-element generation, overcoming and transformation; header identifies facsimile of Qu family Ming print. Author's words not a verified Yuan folio or day-master algorithm.

sources.title: 《存復齋文集》CADAL02099917同篇
sources.quality_notes: Received OCR has corruptions including extra 聖 and 曰 for 日; core four fields and 五行生克制化 corroborated. Page label 卷二 is not the textual juan-four identification; original image and copy linkage unverified.

sources.title: 許有壬《至正集》卷三十三廖如川贈文
sources.quality_notes: Received text says 武昌識廖如川 and 其學虛中之學, and 年月日所直 for trials. This is attribution by author, not proof of direct teaching from Tang Li or a three-pillar-only input.

sources.title: 許有壬《至正集》卷三〈贈談命廖如川〉
sources.quality_notes: Poem names Liao and alludes to Han Yu's inscription for Li Xuzhong. Same author not independent third person testimony; no operating chart.

sources.title: 舒頔《貞素齋集》卷二〈贈星者房景星序〉
sources.quality_notes: Fang's attributed speech separates celestial longitude, Hetu Luoshu number lore and Xu Ziping's five-element teaching; exact composition year unstated. No attested direct pupil relationship, complete natal algorithm or proven founder chronology.

sources.title: 《貞素齋集》四庫提要及洪武辛亥自序
sources.quality_notes: Self-preface dated Hongwu xinhai (1371); Siku editors report Jiajing descendant compilation and Zhao Chun print. Author crossed dynasties, so v2 undated paragraph not automatically pre-1368. No original print leaf.

sources.title: 徐㶿《徐氏筆精》〈子平〉
sources.quality_notes: Distinguishes Xu Juyi from late-Song Xu Yansheng; juxtaposes Song and Five Dynasties claims. Late author retrospective, not a contemporaneous biography or disproof of Xu Juyi's existence.

sources.title: 國圖07191《徐氏筆精》1632邵捷春刊本
sources.provider: Taiwan Digital Archives NCL contributed bibliographic record
sources.quality_notes: Record identifies Chongzhen ren-shen fifth year (1632) Shao Jie-chun print, six physical fascicles; target v8 leaf and identity with SK1821 text not verified.

sources.title: 戴冠《濯纓亭筆記》卷八沈誠子平源流辨說
sources.quality_notes: Reports Chenghua-era Shen Cheng account of Xu Juyi, Li Xuzhong, Chongxu, Daohong and Xu Dasheng; received text reads 年月時 whereas later Sanming Huitong reads 年月日時; original physical glyphs not adjudicated. Not a firsthand Five Dynasties or Song chain.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Xu Youren's attribution of Liao to Li Xuzhong is not proof of direct teacher chain
Fang Jingxing's self-reported pursuit of Xu Ziping teachings does not prove discipleship or identify Xu Juyi versus Xu Yansheng
Undated Shu text cannot be assigned to Yuan solely by author label
Dai's reported Shen Cheng account and later Ming lineage accounts are not independent Song biographies
unresolved_lineage_questions: Bind Zhu/Xu target leaves and identify actual Liao calculation, school and dated encounters
Date Shu v2 passage, recover Jiajing physical leaf, identify historical Xu Ziping
Collate Xu Bijing v8 1632 original and Dai versus Sanming Huitong birth-fields variants
